name: Berti Schneider
original_name: ベルティ・シュナイダー
source:
Louise's client.

Although he has a persecution complex, he's handsome, well-bred, and intelligent. He's just unlucky. Although he might be somewhat obsessed, it would not be an exaggeration to label Hagen as the cause of his problems.

[From in-game profile]

[spoiler]During the request, Berti Schneider realizes that he is actually in love with Hagen.[spoiler]
